title: Choose the landing composition
question: The cartoon system stays. Pick how the first viewport is built — live examples first, then install.

options.label: Split bench
options.lineage: Engineer’s bench: usage on the left, running studio on the right
options.thesis: Install copy sits beside a live North studio dashboard, so seeing and using happen in one glance.
options.viewport: Sticky cartoon sidebar. Left third is How to use with npm install and a CodeBlock. Right two-thirds is a live dashboard built from CodedDesign. Primary button See examples sits on the code side. Below the fold: recipe cards with code, then Components and Docs links.
options.risk: Reads like a docs site before it feels like a product, if the live studio is small.

raised.raise: One default-focused next control (See examples) that cannot be missed.
The page rises in named courses — See, Use, Components, Docs — each with its own band.

options.label: Splash panel
options.lineage: A cartoon splash page with one giant live panel
options.thesis: The first screen is a tilted product splash: stickers, speech bubble, and a full dashboard you can poke.
options.viewport: No hero essay. A huge rounded panel fills the viewport: savings dashboard with cards, progress, and buttons. Stickers (Round, Soft, Squish) pin the corners. A speech bubble says Keep poking, then install. npm install is a small sticker, not a column.
options.risk: Playful chrome can hide the install path if the sticker is too cute.

options.label: Play first
options.lineage: A toy you use before anyone mentions npm
options.thesis: The landing is a working chat and questionnaire; install appears only after you have used a control.
options.viewport: Full-width cartoon chat taking the first screen. You can send a line. A questionnaire sits under it: What should we prototype next? After the first click, a sticky bar reveals npm install @kenselasie/codeddesign and links to recipes.
options.risk: Engineers who came to copy code may bounce before they find the install bar.

options.label: Four views
options.lineage: Character reference sheet, translated into CodedDesign composition only
options.thesis: One product drawn four ways — dashboard, chat, form, controls — with a token swatch row that lights the parts it governs.
options.viewport: A title strip CodedDesign. Four equal live views across the width. Under them, a row of named swatches (Ink, Pink, Blue, Cream). Clicking Pink highlights every pink control in all four views. Recipes and install sit under the swatch row.
options.case: Wins designer browse and proves the system is a kit; loses slightly for engineers who want install copy in the first three seconds.
options.risk: Four live apps at once can feel like a sticker sheet instead of a site.

options.label: Install wizard
options.case: A public package must not nag or gate on a serial field.

options.label: Coil courses
options.case: Clay-course metaphor does not help an engineer identify a design system.
options.kept: Named vertical courses for See, Use, Components, Docs.
